name: OpenStreetMap offshore wind source feature collection
abstract: Source-aligned profile of the supplied Polish Baltic offshore wind GeoJSON snapshot dated 2026-10-27. It preserves OSM node, way, and relation types, numeric OSM identifiers, raw tags, relation members, supplied GeoJSON geometry including null, and source attribution.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap elements: nodes, ways, and relations
IHO S-100 Registry: Category of Offshore Production Area

description:
# OpenStreetMap offshore wind source feature collection

This block describes the source representation of the Polish Baltic OSM snapshot retrieved on 2026-10-27. It preserves the supplied FeatureCollection `type`, attribution string, feature `id`, GeoJSON `geometry` (including null), and the original `osm_type`, numeric `osm_id`, `tags`, and optional relation `members`. The tag dictionary is preserved as JSON data because OSM tag keys are open-ended and several keys contain colons; the model does not silently reinterpret them.

The snapshot contains 292 features: 287 nodes with Point geometry, four ways with Polygon geometry, and one relation with null geometry. The source record has 32 distinct observed tag keys. Nodes, ways, and relations are distinct OSM element kinds, and element identifiers are scoped by element kind. The source `id` is therefore kept as a literal reference (`node/…`, `way/…`, or `relation/…`) rather than treated as an absolute URI.

The attribution string records OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, the OSM API endpoint, retrieval date, and geographic note. The original metadata does not include the exact request URL, bounding box, query, or unconverted response body, so an identical upstream response cannot be reconstructed. This block describes the supplied GeoJSON artifact exactly as received; it does not fetch, filter, parse, or rebuild OSM elements. Any conversion from a future raw OSM response belongs in an explicitly separate downstream transformation, with both the raw response and derived output retained. The snapshot is not a stable or authoritative national inventory. See [OpenStreetMap copyright](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) and the [OSM element model](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Elements).

## IHO semantics

IHO S-100 Data Dictionary item 42 is “Category of Offshore Production Area”, defined as the classification of an area at sea within which production facilities exist. Its listed value “Wind Farm” is applicable to wind-farm area features when source tags explicitly identify that category. The transform in the companion harmonized block only asserts this IHO value when the OSM tags identify a wind farm (`industrial=windfarm` or `seamark:landmark:production_area=wind_farm`); it does not assign the area category to individual turbine nodes or to ambiguous features. The IHO attribute is documented at the [IHO Geospatial Information Registry](https://registry.iho.int/fdd/view3.do?idx=42&type=3).

The full snapshot is included as an example and test resource. OSM data is licensed under the [Open Database License 1.0](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/); retain the source attribution when redistributing it.

examples.title: Raw OSM API XML response for the supplied GeoJSON extent (2026-11-02)
examples.content: Unconverted XML response body saved directly from the OSM API. This is a fresh snapshot, not a reproduction of the 2026-10-27 GeoJSON artifact: its original request bounds were unavailable, so this request uses that artifact's extent (16.74361,54.953732,17.78045,55.13824). Retrieved 2026-11-02 under the [ODbL 1.0](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/); attribution: [OpenStreetMap contributors](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Source request: [OSM API map endpoint](https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/map?bbox=16.74361,54.953732,17.78045,55.13824).

$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: OpenStreetMap offshore wind snapshot
description: Source-aligned GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Feature fields and OSM properties
  retain the supplied source representation; geometry is nullable and may be Point
  or Polygon in this snapshot. Tag keys and values remain uninterpreted.
type: object
required:
- type
- source
- features
properties:
  type:
    const: FeatureCollection
    x-jsonld-id: '@type'
  source:
    type: string
    description: Source attribution, API endpoint, retrieval date, and geographic
      filter recorded with the snapshot.
    x-jsonld-id: http://purl.org/dc/terms/source
  features:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - type
      - geometry
      - properties
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Original OSM element reference in type/id form, such as node/123.
          x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#sourceElementReference
          x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string
        type:
          const: Feature
          x-jsonld-id: '@type'
        geometry:
          oneOf:
          - type: 'null'
          - type: object
            required:
            - type
            - coordinates
            properties:
              type:
                enum:
                - Point
                - Polygon
                x-jsonld-id: '@type'
              coordinates:
                x-jsonld-id: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#coordinates
                x-jsonld-container: '@list'
            additionalProperties: true
          x-jsonld-id: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#geometry
        properties:
          type: object
          required:
          - osm_type
          - osm_id
          - tags
          properties:
            osm_type:
              type: string
              enum:
              - node
              - way
              - relation
              description: OSM element kind.
              x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#elementType
            osm_id:
              type: integer
              minimum: 0
              description: Numeric identifier scoped by osm_type.
              x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#elementIdentifier
              x-jsonld-type: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer
            tags:
              type: object
              description: Unmodified key-value tags from the source; keys and values
                are source-defined strings.
              additionalProperties:
                type: string
              x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#tagSet
              x-jsonld-type: '@json'
            members:
              type: array
              description: Source member references with roles for OSM relations,
                preserved in source order.
              items:
                type: string
              x-jsonld-id: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#relationMemberReference
              x-jsonld-container: '@list'
          additionalProperties: true
          x-jsonld-id: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#properties
      additionalProperties: false
    x-jsonld-id: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#features
    x-jsonld-container: '@set'
additionalProperties: false
x-jsonld-extra-terms:
  FeatureCollection: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#FeatureCollection
  Feature: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#Feature
  Point: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#Point
  Polygon: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#Polygon
  MultiPoint: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#MultiPoint
  LineString: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#LineString
  MultiLineString: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#MultiLineString
  MultiPolygon: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#MultiPolygon
  GeometryCollection: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#GeometryCollection
x-jsonld-prefixes:
  geojson: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#
  osmdata: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/osm-offshore-wind-source#
  xsd: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#
  dcterms: http://purl.org/dc/terms/
  schema: https://schema.org/
x-bblocks-metadata:
  itemIdentifier: ogc.hosted.seadots.osm-offshore-wind-source
  register: https://ogcincubator.github.io/bblocks-seadots/build/register.json
